quest.title: Liyue: Theater Mechanicus
quest.description: Ruijin from Liyue Harbor is promoting a new "game"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Look at all the people gathered over there.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: Hello! Would you like to play a round of Theater Mechanicus?

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: Oh, never heard of it? Allow me to introduce it to you then. Theater Mechanicus is a kind of tabletop game invented by yours truly.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: Do you see these things laid out on the table here? These are all important items used in Theater Mechanicus.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: It may seem complicated, but you'll get the hang of it after you play a couple of times.

dialogues.speaker: Ruijin
dialogues.text: So, how about it? Would you like to give it a try?

choices.text: Uh, well how much does it cost to play?

response.speaker: Ruijin
response.text: No, not at all. It is the Lantern Rite, after all. Besides, I was hoping to collect everyone's initial impressions of the game.

response.speaker: Ruijin
response.text: So all it'll cost you to play is a single Xiao Lantern.

response.speaker: Ruijin
response.text: If you'd like to try, just bring me a Xiao Lantern and you'll be good to go!

response.speaker: Ruijin
response.text: C'mon, give it a try! I'll even let you play the first round for free and you can keep your Xiao Lantern.
